$comment: Short motion pieces drawn on the canvas, each frame a pure function of its time, moving the way the Hoplite website moves (its stylesheets in brand/reference/site-css/, 29p0rb2sqf0_1.css): the globe's and the rules' dashes march along their lines at a constant speed (hero-globe-march and hero-orbit-march, 8s linear), the cog nodes turn a sixth of a turn and rest (hs-odin: 60deg in the first 15% of 4s on cubic-bezier(.45,0,.2,1)), a bar fills from 4% (hdp-upload: 1.2s on cubic-bezier(.3,0,.2,1)), and a lockup arrives from 92% scale and no opacity (ag-pop: .48s on cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)) while the rules draw in (ag-draw: 1s on cubic-bezier(.45,0,.2,1)). No ease-in, nothing from zero scale; the loops meet their first frame.

globe.name: Globe
globe.description: The globe template with its dashes marching and its nodes turning a sixth of a turn every 4 seconds; seamless loop.

cube.name: Cube
cube.description: The cube template with its dashes marching and its nodes turning; seamless loop.

horizon.name: Horizon
horizon.description: The centered headline over the marching dome, its pole node turning; seamless loop.

loader.name: Loader
loader.description: The bar fills from 4% to the progress on the site's upload curve, then holds while its dashes march.

logo.name: Logo
logo.description: The lockup arrives (92% scale and no opacity to rest) over the dome, then the dome's dashes march and its nodes turn.
